title: 2020 Hathras gang rape and murder
narrative: FIR — 2020 Hathras gang rape and murder, Hathras district, Uttar Pradesh. On 14 September 2020, a 19-year-old Dalit woman was assaulted and gang-raped in a field; she sustained severe injuries and named four upper-caste men, Sandeep, Ravi, Luv Kush and Ramu, as her attackers. She died of her injuries at a Delhi hospital on 29 September 2020. Her body was cremated by the police at night, drawing national outrage. On 2 March 2023, a special court convicted Sandeep under culpable homicide and the SC/ST Act while acquitting the other three accused.
